source.title: Turnkey PCBA vs. Consignment PCBA: Which PCB Assembly Service Is Right for Your Business? - Hitech Circuits
source.body:
Frequently Asked Questions About Turnkey and Consignment PCBA
Is turnkey PCBA better than consignment PCBA?
Neither option is universally better. Turnkey PCBA may suit businesses seeking integrated material sourcing and assembly, while consignment PCBA may suit customers that prefer to purchase and manage their own components.

Is consignment PCBA always cheaper?
No. Although the assembly quotation may exclude component procurement, the customer must also account for purchasing costs, logistics, inventory handling, and material coordination. The total project cost depends on the specific requirements and purchasing arrangements.

Can I supply some components and ask the manufacturer to source the rest?
In many cases, a partial consignment arrangement may be possible. The customer and supplier should agree on which materials will be supplied by each party, how the materials will be identified, and how shortages will be handled.

Does turnkey PCBA include functional testing?
Not necessarily. Functional testing depends on the supplier's service scope and the customer's requirements. Firmware, test fixtures, programming, and acceptance criteria may need to be provided or quoted separately.

What files are needed for turnkey PCBA?
Commonly required files include a BOM, Gerber files, pick-and-place data, assembly drawings, order quantity, and testing requirements.

How can I get a quotation for PCB assembly?
Prepare the available manufacturing files and specify the order quantity, testing requirements, and preferred material supply model. A PCBA supplier can then review the project and clarify any additional information needed for quotation.

Conclusion
Choosing between turnkey PCBA and consignment PCBA requires a clear understanding of purchasing responsibilities, material availability, production coordination, and total manufacturing costs.

Turnkey PCBA can simplify supply chain management by coordinating component sourcing and assembly through one supplier. Consignment PCBA gives customers greater direct control over component procurement and may be suitable when they already have the required materials or established purchasing arrangements.

The right choice depends on your project requirements, internal resources, and production strategy.
